iros.full_name: IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems

pattern.deadline_window: Original paper deadline March 1-2 every year (2023: Mar 1; 2024: Mar 1 -> extended Mar 15; 2025: Mar 1 -> extended Mar 2 after a server outage; 2026: Mar 2, no extension; 2027: Mar 1 per IEEE RAS calendar, draft). Deadlines are 23:59 Pacific (PST) on PaperPlaza. Extensions are rare and unpredictable; plan for March 1.
pattern.abstract_deadline: None; IROS has no separate abstract deadline.
pattern.typical_camera_ready: Mid-to-late July (2024: Jul 31, later extended to Aug 31; 2025: Jul 31; 2026: Jul 16).
pattern.typical_conference_month: Late September to late October (2024: Oct 14-18; 2025: Oct 19-25; 2026: Sep 27-Oct 1; 2027: Sep 26-Oct 1; 2028: Oct 2-6).
pattern.location_rotation: Roughly rotates among Americas, Asia/Middle East and Europe/Oceania: 2021 Prague (CZ), 2022 Kyoto (JP), 2023 Detroit (US), 2024 Abu Dhabi (AE), 2025 Hangzhou (CN), 2026 Pittsburgh (US), 2027 Florence (IT), 2028 Sydney (AU, announced; first southern-hemisphere IROS).
pattern.review_process: Papers are reviewed by the IROS Conference Paper Review Board (an associate editor plus reviewers) and decided by the Senior Program Committee; there is no rebuttal phase and reviews are released with the decision on PaperPlaza. Single-blind through 2025; double-anonymous (author-redacted PDFs) from IROS 2026.

journal_transfer_windows.2025: RAS journal transfer deadline 1 May 2025 (window pattern Aug 1, 2024 - Apr 30/May 1, 2025)

resubmission_rules: RA-L pathway: the classic 'RA-L with IROS option' was discontinued in 2024 ('IROS no longer offers an RA-L+IROS submission option'). Instead, papers accepted at RA-L, T-RO, T-ASE, RAM (and in recent years RA-P, T-FR, T-RL and some IES journals) can be transferred for presentation at IROS within a conference-specific window (typically Aug 1 of the prior year to Apr 30) and within 270 days of acceptance; survey papers excluded; a paper may be presented at only one conference. This is the standard route for a paper that misses the March deadline: submit to RA-L (rolling) and transfer.

Rejected-from-ICRA resubmission: ICRA notifications (late Jan/early Feb) precede the IROS deadline (Mar 1-2) by roughly a month, so an ICRA reject can be revised and resubmitted to IROS; from 2026 the IROS PDF must be anonymized.

Dual submission / arXiv: the IROS 2024-2026 CFP pages checked do not state an explicit arXiv or concurrent-submission policy; standard IEEE rules on originality and against simultaneous submission apply via the PaperPlaza submission terms, and IROS 2026's double-anonymous process only requires redacting the submitted PDF. Verify on PaperPlaza at submission time.

Final version must closely match the accepted version ('changes only made to address the reviewers' comments'); in-person presentation by an author (or knowledgeable substitute) is expected; at least one author must register before the final upload.
Page limits: 6 + up to 2 paid extra pages (2024-2025); up to 8 pages (2026). Video attachment optional, only at submission time.

editions.name: IROS 2024
editions.full_name: 2024 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems
notes: Paper deadline extended by two weeks: March 1 -> March 15, 2024 (video deadline March 5 -> March 19/20; workshop/tutorial March 15 -> March 22). All deadlines 23:59 PST.
Final (camera-ready) paper deadline was also extended: July 31 -> August 31, 2024 (per the Aug 2024 snapshot of the official page).
No rebuttal phase; reviews are released with the acceptance decision (June 30, 2024) on PaperPlaza.

RA-L option: 'IROS no longer offers an RA-L+IROS submission option.' Instead, papers accepted at RA-L, T-RO, RAM and T-ASE between August 1, 2023 and April 30, 2024 were offered presentation at IROS 2024 (journal-transfer window).
Page limit 6 pages + up to 2 extra pages (references included). In-person presentation expected; remote option only if unable to travel; 5-minute on-demand video required.
Review blinding not stated on the archived 2024 CFP (IROS was single-blind through 2025 per the 2025 CFP FAQ).
Submission statistics disagree between sources: IEEE RAS news says 3,753 submissions; csconfstats lists 1,600 accepted / 3,400 submitted (47.1%). Trust the IEEE RAS figure for submissions.
The live site iros2024-abudhabi.org is behind Cloudflare and blocked automated access on 2026-09-21; dates were verified from Wayback Machine snapshots of the official page.

editions.name: IROS 2025
editions.full_name: 2025 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems
notes: Original deadline March 1, 2025 (23:59 PST); extended by one day to March 2, 2025 (23:59 PST) because of a PaperPlaza server breakdown in the last minutes, even though the CFP FAQ said 'There is no plan to extend the paper submission deadline.' Do not count on IROS extensions.
Video attachments accepted only in two windows: Jan 5-Feb 24, 2025 and Mar 3-6, 2025 (23:59 PST).

Review process single-blind ('reviewers stay anonymous, but author information is visible'); Conference Paper Review Board reviews, Senior Program Committee decides. No rebuttal. Reviews/AE remarks accessible on PaperPlaza after notification.

No RA-L+IROS submission option. Journal-transfer program instead: non-evolutionary published RA-L, T-ASE, T-RO, RAM papers (plus RA-P, T-FR, and in 2025 also IES journals T-IE, T-II, T-MECH) eligible within a window; RAS journal transfer deadline 1 May 2025; IES journals extended. IROS 2025 received 777 journal transfers (per search summary of official news; treat as approximate).

Page limit 6 pages + up to 2 extra pages at 180 USD/page (references included). Final version 31 July 2025 (23:59 PST); at least one author registered before final upload; all presenting authors registered by 31 July 2025.
In-person conference; alternative (video) presentation offered to accepted authors unable to travel. Over 8,000 attendees per the organizers.
Acceptance statistics (secondary, csconfstats): 1,991 accepted / 4,306 submitted (46.2%).
iros25.org and its mirror 2025.ieee-iros.org served an expired TLS certificate on 2026-09-21; pages were fetched with certificate checking disabled.

editions.name: IROS 2026
editions.full_name: 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems
notes: As of 2026-09-21 the conference has NOT yet taken place (starts in 6 days, Sep 27 - Oct 1, 2026); the submission/notification/camera-ready milestones have all passed.

Paper deadline March 2, 2026; 'Submissions may be modified, but not started, through March 5'. No extension was announced (searches found none; the official pages show the original date). Time of day is not printed next to the paper deadline; the video deadline on the same page is '23:59 PST' and PaperPlaza deadlines are Pacific time, so 23:59 PST is assumed.

Minor inconsistency on official pages: Important Dates lists paper-video submissions March 7, 2026, while the CFP says video upload 'no later than March 5, 2026 (23:59 PST)'. Late Breaking Results deadline is July 31 on Important Dates but August 10 on the home page.
First IROS with double-anonymous review: 'The IROS review process is double-anonymous (both reviewers and authors stay anonymous).' Author names/affiliations must be redacted. No rebuttal phase.
Page limit raised: 'Papers should be up to eight pages (US letter size) in length.' Oral-session format preference due June 30, 2026; final papers July 16, 2026.
No RA-L+IROS submission option. Journal-transfer window for IROS 2026 (RAS journals RA-L/T-RO/T-ASE/RAM/T-RL): August 1, 2025 to April 30, 2026, with the 270-days-from-acceptance rule.
In-person presentation expected: 'All papers accepted at the 2026 IROS are to be presented, in person, by the author/co-author or a knowledgeable person on the subject matter.'
Acceptance statistics (secondary, csconfstats): 1,585 accepted / 4,348 submitted (36.5%) - a noticeably lower rate than 2024-2025.

editions.name: IROS 2027
editions.full_name: 2027 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems
notes: Conference dates and venue are official (2027.ieee-iros.org and IEEE RAS calendar): September 26 - October 1, 2027, Fortezza da Basso, Florence. Theme: 'Human-Centric Robots for Sustainable Life'.

PAPER DEADLINE IS NOT YET ON THE CONFERENCE WEBSITE. The March 1, 2027 date comes from the IEEE RAS (co-sponsor) event calendar ('Paper submission deadline: IROS Mar 1, 2027'); aconf and mldeadlines carry the same date and label it a 'draft' deadline. It matches the 2023-2027 pattern (March 1-2). Treat as provisional until 2027.ieee-iros.org publishes its Call for Papers.
Deadline time/zone (23:59 PST) is assumed from the 2024-2026 pattern, not announced.
Notification date is ESTIMATED from the pattern (June 16 in 2026, June 30 in 2024 and 2025): expect mid-to-late June 2027; camera-ready expected mid-to-late July 2027 (not announced).

Journal-transfer window is official: RA-L/T-RO papers accepted August 1, 2026 to April 30, 2027 may be transferred for presentation at IROS 2027 (270-day rule; survey papers excluded). No RA-L+IROS submission option.
Review format (double-anonymous, as introduced in 2026) and page limit not yet announced for 2027.
